howto.name: Enter the two texts
howto.text: Paste the original text on the left and the modified text on the right, or upload two text files.

howto.name: View the diff
howto.text: Differences are highlighted inline: green for additions, red for deletions, and yellow for modifications.

howto.name: Choose diff mode
howto.text: Switch between side-by-side and unified views. Line numbers help locate changes in large documents.

howto.name: Copy or download the diff
howto.text: Copy the highlighted diff to your clipboard or download it as an HTML file for sharing.

faq.a: The tool uses a line-by-line diff algorithm similar to Unix diff, highlighting additions, deletions, and modifications with color coding.
Yes. Upload two text files instead of pasting. Supported formats include .txt, .csv, .json, .xml, .html, .css, .js, .py, and other plain-text formats.

faq.q: Is there a file size limit for comparison?
faq.a: Each file can be up to 500 MB. Very large files may take a few seconds to process the diff.
Yes. The diff viewer works with any plain-text format. It highlights changes line by line, making it useful for comparing code, configs, or data files.
